info.name: QR Code
info.summary: Generate styled QR codes, including for file links
info.description:
Generate styled QR codes inside Nextcloud.
- Generator page: encode a URL, text, email, SMS, location, Wi-Fi, or a contact (vCard). Choose colours, transparency, error-correction level and size; download as PNG or SVG, or save straight into your Files. - Files sharing sidebar: a QR code for a file's internal link or one of its existing public links, using your colours and presets. It is read-only and never creates a share. - Save reusable colour presets and appearance defaults in Personal settings.
QR codes render entirely in your browser; nothing is sent to an external service. Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Slovak, Czech and Polish.
info.author: Peter Svihra
